item.title: Week 10: Hologram Projector
item.description: Holograms & Pepper’s Ghost Ever been to Disneyworld? Have you been on the Haunted Mansion ride? Throughout that ride, ghosts appear in the rooms before you (and -spoiler- sometimes, in the ghost-mobile with you). Perhaps you’ve been to or have heard of concerts where a dead performer takes the stage again via ‘hologram’? These are all achieved by an illusion called ‘Pepper’s Ghost’. This is the same effect that teleprompters use too by the way.
